summary: Dirt lane running along house fences; dwellings 3-6 m away.
reasons: Houses 3 m and 6 m from line

best_section.where: Western end of the dirt lane, near the Kinloch Street side corner under trees

drivers.seclusion: North side is the back fence of occupied houses; mapped dwellings within 3-6 m along the lane and homes on the south side too.
drivers.access_and_room: Dirt lane with a car parked on it, so a van can get in, but it is narrow and between fences.
drivers.traffic: Quiet; a main road runs just west of the far end.
drivers.convention: No parking convention on the lane itself; cars park on Kinloch Street nearby.

flags: Dwelling within 10 m of the lane
Low-lying: 7-9 m elevation, Witton Creek 51 m away
Likely a private drive or access easement
sun_shade: Mixed; tree canopy over the western end, open in the middle, house shade from the north.
